_comment: Every TypeScript declaration of the daemon-launch descriptor schema version.
The checker scans this repository for unregistered declarations, so adding a mirror
requires an explicit decision here. The producer-side registry and wire fingerprint
remain in yschimke/compose-ai-tools; this list owns only this repository's tree.

schemaVersionSites.why: The extension rejects daemon-launch.json descriptors whose version differs from this reader constant.
